name: Voice panel
responsibility: mountVoice(element, url): a working voice panel over one voice client, so a host has an agent in one line
description: Native controls, accessible status updates, the system's light and dark colors and replaceable English words; it carries no stylesheet beyond them. A custom page builds on createVoiceClient instead and gets the same reconnect and restoration behavior.

outgoing.label: one voice client on the host's socket URL
